title: Motion Machine sound profile (SPEC §9): a style's sound look
description: What a family of cues shares: where it sits in pitch, how its notes begin and fade, its material, its level and its room. A style or brand names one (`sound.profile`) once; the cues it plays are voiced by it (synth.js `applyProfile`) and, where the gate looks, measured against it. Shipped in styles/sound/<name>.json; a path to another file also works.

maxCentreHz.description: nothing is centred above this: a tone's fundamental is folded down by octaves, a band-pass centre is capped

minHz.description: nothing sounds below this: a lower fundamental is folded up by octaves, a lower partial is dropped

tones.description: what the oscillators are; the renderer draws sines, so the field says what a mined set was

key.description: the pitch classes the cues' fundamentals sit on (no tonic: a set, not a scale); empty for no constraint

attackS.description: [shortest, longest] attack of a struck note

t60.description: [shortest, longest] T60 of a note by family (familyOf): input up to 0.06 s long, surface up to 0.3 s, outcome up to 0.65 s

modes.description: the material: `bar` inharmonic bar ratios (1 : 2.76 : 5.4), `mallet` (1 : 3.99), `string` harmonic whole-number ratios, `none` pure sines. `none` strips a recipe's partials and `string` snaps them to whole numbers; the others leave the recipe's own

cueLufs100ms.description: the level every cue is matched to: its loudest 100 ms, K-weighted, on the stereo render

tolDb.description: how far a cue may sit from that level

peakDbfs.description: the highest sample peak a cue may reach

send.description: dB under the dry cue; -22 is the reference a recipe's own send is written against

sideMidDb.description: the side signal's level under the mid, dB: a cue is nearly centred, with a little width

sources.description: where a mined profile's sounds came from; a cue cloned from it carries them. Absent for a profile written by hand
